items.originalExcerpt: Four people were injured after a public transport bus crashed through a guardrail and crossed into oncoming traffic on Tsarigradsko Shose Boulevard in Sofia on Monday, temporarily blocking one of the capital's busiest roads. The Route 204 bus, which was traveling from the Mladost district toward Orlov Most, broke through the central barrier near the Fourth Kilometer interchange.
